description: Zurich has three runway pairs: 10/28, 14/32 and 16/34. Headings are TRUE, not magnetic, because LSZH METAR wind direction is reported relative to true north (confirmed from MeteoSwiss's own flight-weather documentation) and runway heading must match the wind-report reference frame (docs/NEW_AIRPORT_QUESTIONS.md section 2). SkyVector's magnetic headings (152/332, 134/314, 093/273) were cross-checked against Sprinkle.com's true headings below; the few-degree gap matches Switzerland's magnetic declination, supporting the true set. Not checked against the Swiss AIP (charts 10-P/10-P1) — see docs/LSZH_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md.
source: Sprinkle.com (true headings, decimal-degree thresholds), cross-checked against SkyVector (magnetic headings), 29-10-2026. Not checked against the Swiss AIP.
